releaseNotes:
🚀 Update System
- Added remote Mandatory/Optional Update control.

⚡ Performance
- Improved APK detection and storage synchronization.
- Reduced unnecessary downloads.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Fixed APK detection across refreshes, pagination and app data changes.
- Improved real-time download status updates.

✨ Improvements
- Existing APKs now show Install instead of Download.
- Preserved download progress and non-APK Open behavior.
